text_block_list.text:
And the winner of the sister showdown
of the
century is Бива Хаяхидэ! Biwa
Hayahide takes
home the big win!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I did it...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: I beat Brian.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: ...Sis.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: You really are fast.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Brian...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I knew signing up for this race was the
right thing
to do. I got to see you at
your best.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Chasing after you made me remember
how we
used to run together when we
were kids.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
All I wanted was to pass whoever was in
front of
me. And it wasn't out of a
desperate need, just
pure—
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Ha-ya-hi-de! Ha-ya-hi-de!
text_block_list.name: Spectators

text_block_list.text:
Tch... I can't even hear myself think. I'll
talk to
you later.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Wait, Brian.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Hm?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: I want to know. As I am now...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Am I a big sister you can be proud of?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Pfft, what are you even talking about?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: I've always been proud of you.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
At long last, the sibling showdown is
settled.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
As it turns out, what lies beyond the
equal sign of
Biwa Hayahide's winning
equation... is victory.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
